item.title: Increased error rate on Actor Standby endpoints [resolved]
item.description: The problem has been resolved. Impact was an increased error rate at the Actor Standby API, not other component was affected. There was no downtime during the period of the incident.

item.title: Degraded performance of API operations due to slow database operations [resolved]
item.description: The database is fully recovered, and all systems are operational. We apologize for any inconvenience this might have caused. We are currently implementing new measures to ensure this won't happen again.

item.title: High number of Actor run migrations [resolved]
item.description: All systems are operational, and we apologize for any inconvenience this might have caused.

item.title: Degraded SERP performance [resolved]
item.description: The issue has been resolved. Both the response time and success rate have returned to normal levels.

item.title: Degraded performance of webhooks [resolved]

item.title: Degraded performance of API, Console, and Proxy [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved.

item.title: Proxy degradation [resolved]
item.description:
We experienced degraded performance on our proxy due to an unexpected increase in load. This caused slower response times for some users.
The issue lasted approximately 5 minutes and has been fully resolved. All systems are now operating normally.
We apologize for the inconvenience.

item.title: MCP: Failing OAuth sing-in from clients using CIMD with loopback redirects [resolved]
item.description: We have implemented a fix for the OAuth flow, and the connections are now working normally.

item.title: Outage of Key-value store [resolved]
item.description:
We've resolved an issue where a key-value store API update caused some Actor runs to time out.
If your Actor run timed out you can get it back by resurrecting it. There was no data loss.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

item.description: As of 07:30 UTC, the Apify platform is operating normally. Amazon Web Services have also marked their incident as resolved, which gives us confidence that the outage has concluded. We will continue to monitor the situation and apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

item.title: Issue with apify/send-mail Actor [resolved]
item.description:
The latest version of the apify/send-mail Actor failed to email all recipients. The issue lasted from around 13:50 to 14:05 CEST. The root cause was identified, and the service of the Actor was restored.
We apologize for any inconvenience this might have caused. We take this problem seriously and will take steps to prevent such issues from occurring in the future.
